title: Implementation review result
description: The machine-readable tail of a /phase-review report. Consumed by drive-triage.mjs.

verdict.description: REJECTED on any CRITICAL; NEEDS_ATTENTION on any WARNING; APPROVED otherwise.

base.description: Base commit-ish of the reviewed diff.

head.description: Head commit-ish of the reviewed diff.

gate_recorded.description: True when the implementer's automated-gate line was found (drive-log heartbeat or PR description) and read instead of re-run.

observations.description: OBSERVATION-severity notes. Written to <work>/proposed-lessons.md, never fixed.

findings.description: Actionable findings only. The schema enforces both floors: severity is CRITICAL or WARNING (OBSERVATION belongs in observations[], never here) and confidence is >= 80.

failure_scenario.description: Required for CRITICAL: the concrete sequence (input, state, call order) producing the bad outcome.
